trust_decision.summary: quote() must not emit a raw `#` comment token that swallows the quoting of later tokens: once a `{ comment }` token has been rendered, any later string token containing \n, \r, U+2028 or U+2029 is rejected with a TypeError. The decision is made in quote's per-token map, gated by a `sawComment` flag set in the comment branch.

landing_point.why: The only place quote emits an unescaped `#`, so an engineer who read only the summary (a line terminator in a token after a `{ comment }` token) starts at the comment branch and finds that nothing is carried forward to the tokens rendered after it.

fix_sites.entry_point: quote(xs) (index.js:3, also documented as require('shell-quote/quote') at README.md:115)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A line terminator in a string token is legitimate and must stay allowed when no `{ comment }` precedes it: the token is single-quoted, so the newline is literal and not a command separator, and quote(['a\nb']) must still return "'a\nb'". An over-broad fix that rejects line terminators in every string token, or strips them, breaks this.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: quote.js:60-66; pinned by test/quote.js:17, test/quote.js:21, test/quote.js:48

O6_input_shapes: a string token immediately after a `{ comment }` token containing any of the four line terminators \n, \r, U+2028, U+2029 (fix.diff:76-79)
a string token anywhere later in the array, not just the next one, i.e. the guard is state, not adjacency (fix.diff:80-84)

a string token appended to tokens that `parse` produced after splitting a mid-word `#` (e.g. a URL fragment) into a `{ comment }` entry (fix.diff:85-89; the producer is parse.js:245-251, and quote inspects its output directly, so no producer change is needed)
deliberately not rejected: a line terminator in a string token that appears before the comment (fix.diff:91)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second pattern-carrying token shape (e.g. `{ op: 'redirect', target }` or `{ template }`) rendered with its own escaping beside the glob branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this function has already grown one token shape per advisory (glob, op, comment); a maintainer adding another would copy the glob branch and could omit both the line-terminator check and the after-comment rule

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second comment-like shape (e.g. a shebang variant or `{ comment, prefix: '#' }`) that emits a raw `#` without setting `sawComment`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the comment branch is the only place that emits a raw `#`, so a variant of it is the natural extension and needs the same flag

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a composed helper such as `command(args)` that joins `quote(args)` with a comment banner or extra suffix
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: index.js is the whole package surface and README.md:119-145 already sells quote as the way to build shell text; a convenience wrapper is where a downstream need would be met

O9_family: shell command injection (CWE-78): a `#` comment token suppresses the quoting/escaping of tokens rendered after it
